name: list_project_route_versions
description:
Get the version history for a project's routing rules. Returns the staging version (if one exists) followed by production versions, most recent first. The staging version has `isStaging: true` and the current production version has `isLive: true`.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/versions --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
